boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UMass Amherst rituals and recurring campus gatherings, from a century-old hike to the marching-band welcome route.

cards.title: Mark April 29 at Founders Day
cards.subtitle: Campuswide celebration of UMass Amherst’s 1863 founding
cards.notes: Check the official schedule for open houses, demonstrations, performances, and exhibits, then build a self-guided route around the participating campus spaces.
cards.short_summary: An annual April 29 celebration of UMass Amherst’s founding and present-day campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst calls Founders Day a beloved campus tradition celebrated on April 29; it began as a formal campus celebration in 2010.
cards.access_notes: See the official Founders Day page for the annual program and locations.

cards.title: Follow the Spring Concert lineage
cards.subtitle: University Programming Council’s long-running concert tradition
cards.notes: Watch UPC announcements for the current performer, venue, and attendance details; the official history includes archival concert images and past artists.
cards.short_summary: A campus concert tradition stewarded by the student-run University Programming Council.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst identifies the Spring Concert as one of its longest-running traditions and says UPC has upheld it for nearly 70 years.
cards.source_title: Inside UPC: Student Leadership, Campus Events, and Tradition | UMass Amherst
cards.access_notes: Performance details and entry requirements vary by year.

cards.title: Find the Big Chill program
cards.subtitle: UPC’s recurring campus stress-relief gathering
cards.notes: Look for UPC’s current event notice before heading out, and use the listed activities as a daytime break between classes or study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A recurring UPC campus event named by UMass among its beloved traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst lists Big Chill among the campus traditions planned by the University Programming Council.
cards.source_title: Inside UPC: Student Leadership, Campus Events, and Tradition | UMass Amherst
cards.access_notes: Check UPC or the university events calendar for the current date and location.

cards.title: Catch UMass Got Talent
cards.subtitle: UPC’s campus talent-show tradition
cards.notes: Follow UPC’s event communications for performer sign-ups or audience details, and plan around the announced venue and program time.
cards.short_summary: A student-programmed talent showcase included in UMass’s UPC tradition lineup.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst names UMass Got Talent as one of the beloved campus traditions organized through UPC.
cards.source_title: Inside UPC: Student Leadership, Campus Events, and Tradition | UMass Amherst
cards.access_notes: Check UPC or the university events calendar for current participation and audience information.

cards.title: Plant a bulb for spring
cards.subtitle: Commonwealth Honors College’s Family Weekend tradition
cards.notes: If the event returns during Family Weekend, join the planting tutorial and follow staff guidance so the bulbs can become part of the next spring’s display.
cards.short_summary: An annual CHC bulb-planting event honoring former Honors Dean Priscilla Clarkson.
cards.evidence_claim: Commonwealth Honors College describes its annual Family Weekend daffodil planting as a long-standing tradition established by Priscilla Clarkson.
cards.source_title: A Blooming Tradition: Commonwealth Honors College Hosts Annual Daffodil Planting Event During Family Weekend
cards.access_notes: Participation and location are announced with Family Weekend programming.

cards.title: Learn the Metawampe Hike story
cards.subtitle: UMass Amherst Chemistry Department’s Mount Toby hike
cards.notes: Use the department’s account to understand the hike’s history, then confirm whether a current outing is being offered before making any travel or trail plans.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Chemistry Department hike associated with Mount Toby and local history.
cards.evidence_claim: A UMass Chemistry Department publication documented the 2018 outing as the 111th annual Metawampe Hike.
cards.access_notes: This is an off-campus hike; confirm current organizers, route, weather, and accessibility before attending.

cards.title: Plan around Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual fall campus-and-family gathering
cards.notes: Review the current Family Weekend itinerary with guests, reserve only the activities that need it, and leave time for campus events and academic-college visits.
cards.short_summary: An annual UMass Amherst weekend that brings students’ families to campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst describes Family Weekend as a special annual tradition inviting families to campus for a weekend of activities.
cards.source_title: UMass Amherst Family Weekend Confirmation Brochure
cards.access_notes: Dates, reservations, and activity access vary by year.

cards.title: Join Flagship Fall: Homecoming
cards.subtitle: UMass Amherst’s fall celebration of connection and pride
cards.notes: Use the official Homecoming announcement to choose family-friendly public events, then verify the next year’s schedule before heading to campus or downtown.
cards.short_summary: A fall UMass gathering that combines campus, community, performances, and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst presented Flagship Fall: Homecoming 2025 as a two-day celebration of connection, tradition, and pride.
cards.source_title: UMass Amherst Invites Local Community to Celebrate Flagship Fall: Homecoming 2025
cards.access_notes: Homecoming programming changes annually; confirm the current schedule and event access.

cards.title: Walk the Minuteman March
cards.subtitle: Convocation-to-Welcome-Barbeque march with the UMass Marching Band
cards.notes: New students can follow Convocation guidance for the class photo and band-led route; spectators should check the current Welcome to the U schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A band-led welcome route connecting New Student Convocation with the Fall Welcome Barbeque.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst described the Minuteman March from New Student Convocation to the Fall Welcome Barbeque as traditional.
cards.source_title: Special Events Planned Labor Day Weekend to Mark Arrival of Students and Opening of Fall Semester at UMass Amherst
cards.access_notes: Typically part of fall welcome programming; confirm timing and route with New Student and Family Programs.

cards.title: Arrive at the Fall Welcome Barbeque
cards.subtitle: Haigis Mall welcome gathering after Convocation
cards.notes: Check the current welcome schedule and dining information, then use the event as a simple first-week opportunity to orient yourself around Haigis Mall.
cards.short_summary: A fall welcome gathering recognized by UMass as a campus tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Amherst’s Common Data Set appendix identifies the Welcome Barbeque among fall-semester campus traditions.
cards.source_title: UMass Amherst Common Data Set Appendix 2015–2016
cards.access_notes: Current food offerings, timing, and eligibility should be verified through the Welcome to the U schedule.
